raw.details:
Craft N Code – Karnataka State Qualifier

This State Round is exclusively for students studying in colleges across Karnataka. Please register only if your institution is located in Karnataka.

Get ready to showcase your innovation, creativity, and coding skills at the Craft N Code Karnataka State Qualifier, organized by RVCE & RVITM. This qualifier provides an opportunity for Karnataka's talented student innovators to showcase their skills and compete for a chance to advance to the Craft N Code National Hackathon, hosted by IIIT Bhubaneswar.

The Karnataka State Qualifier will follow a structured evaluation process where teams will get the opportunity to understand the challenge, brainstorm innovative ideas, develop technology-driven solutions, and present their projects. Participants will be evaluated on their problem-solving approach, innovation, technical implementation, creativity, presentation, and overall impact of their solutions.

Important Dates:

  • Registration Opens: 28 August 2026
  • Online 48hrs Hackathon: 17-18 October 2026

Craft N Code is more than just a coding competition, it is a platform for solving real-world problems through technology, collaboration, creativity, and innovation. Participants will get the opportunity to transform their ideas into practical solutions while working alongside talented students and developers from across Karnataka.

What's in it for you?

  • An opportunity to compete at the Craft N Code State Qualifier
  • A chance to advance toward the Craft N Code National Hackathon at IIIT Bhubaneswar
  • Showcase your creativity and technical expertise
  • Collaborate with talented students and innovators
  • Gain experience solving real-world problem statements
  • Earn certificates and recognition
  • Strengthen your resume and technical portfolio
  • Network with fellow developers and technology enthusiasts

If you're ready to challenge yourself, build innovative solutions, and showcase your technical skills, this is your opportunity to step forward.

Gather your team, register from 28 August 2026, and get ready to Craft N Code!

Let's innovate. Let's build. Let's Craft N Code.
